answer: Agents must stake saffron-bloom bonds redeemable after a wander across a blockchain-vine’s trellised audits. Auditors plant split-test vines every epoch; each clone must re-wander the same node-path while a drone zaps the trellis with pulsed light. Failing the audit burns 0.7µg of staked saffron-indica cubic crystals, and the original stake stays frozen. Cost: 0.7µg per extra identity, sunk permanently.
